create_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger to track and log training metrics with smoothed values over a window
create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue tracker to compute median, average, and max over a sliding window of values
init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode using environment variables for rank, world size, and GPU assignment
save_on_master: save a PyTorch checkpoint to disk only on the main process in a distributed training setup
log_every: use MetricLogger log_every to iterate over a dataloader and print periodic training progress with ETA
